sentences.zh: 洪武元年躬祀汴梁諸神，仍遣官祭境內山川。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1 he personally sacrificed to the spirits of Bianliang and still dispatched officials to sacrifice to mountains and rivers within the domain.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 he personally sacrificed to the spirits of Bianliang and still dispatched officials to sacrifice to mountains and rivers within the domain.

sentences.zh: 二年，以天下山川祔祭嶽瀆壇。

translations.literal: In the second year mountains and rivers throughout the realm were offered in collateral sacrifice at the peaks and rivers altar.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 mountains and rivers throughout the realm were offered in collateral sacrifice at the peaks and rivers altar.

sentences.zh: 帝又以安南、高麗皆臣附，其國內山川，宜與中國同祭。

translations.literal: The emperor also held that since Annam and Goryeo were both submissive vassals, mountains and rivers within their states should be sacrificed to the same as China.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also held that since Annam and Goryeo were both submissive vassals, mountains and rivers within their states should be sacrificed to the same as China.

sentences.zh: 諭中書及禮官考之。

translations.literal: He instructed the Secretariat and ritual officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the Secretariat and ritual officials to investigate.

sentences.zh: 安南之山二十一，其江六，其水六。

translations.literal: Annam's mountains numbered twenty-one; its rivers six; its streams six.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's mountains numbered twenty-one; its rivers six; its streams six.

sentences.zh: 高麗之山三，其水四。

translations.literal: Goryeo's mountains three; its streams four.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo's mountains three; its streams four.

sentences.zh: 命著祀典，設位以祭。

translations.literal: An order was issued to register them in the sacrificial code and set seats for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to register them in the sacrificial code and set seats for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 三年，遣使往安南、高麗、占城，祀其國山川。

translations.literal: In the third year envoys were dispatched to Annam, Goryeo, and Champa to sacrifice to mountains and rivers in those states.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3 envoys were dispatched to Annam, Goryeo, and Champa to sacrifice to mountains and rivers in those states.

sentences.zh: 帝齋戒，親爲祝文。

translations.literal: The emperor fasted and personally composed the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fasted and personally composed the prayer text.

sentences.zh: 仍遣官頒革正山川神號詔於安南、占城、高麗。

translations.literal: Officials were also dispatched to promulgate the edict rectifying mountain-and-river spirit titles in Annam, Champa, and Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were also sent to promulgate the edict rectifying spirit titles in Annam, Champa, and Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 六年，琉球諸國已朝貢，祀其國山川。

translations.literal: In year six, as the Ryukyu states had already presented tribute, their mountains and rivers were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, with the Ryukyu states already paying tribute, their mountains and rivers were added to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮部尚書牛諒言：「京都既罷祭天下山川，其外國山川，亦非天子所當親祀。

translations.literal: In year eight Minister of Rites Niu Liang said: "The capital has already abolished sacrifice to mountains and rivers throughout the realm; foreign mountains and rivers are also not what the Son of Heaven should sacrifice to in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Minister of Rites Niu Liang argued: "The capital has abolished sacrifice to all realm mountains and rivers; foreign mountains and rivers are not for the Son of Heaven to sacrifice to in person.

sentences.zh: 」中書及禮臣請附祭各省，從之。

translations.literal: " The Secretariat and ritual officials requested attached sacrifice in each province; this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat and ritual officials asked that they be sacrificed to as attached offerings in each province; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 廣西附祭安南、占城、真臘、暹羅、鎖裏，廣東附祭三佛齊、爪哇，福建附祭日本、琉球、渤泥，遼東附祭高麗，陝西附祭甘肅、朵甘、烏斯藏，京城不復祭。

translations.literal: Guangxi attached sacrifice to Annam, Champa, Zhenla, Siam, and Suoli; Guangdong to Sanfoqi and Java; Fujian to Japan, Ryukyu, and Brunei; Liaodong to Goryeo; Shaanxi to Gansu, Do-Kham, and U-Tsang; the capital no longer sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi attached Annam, Champa, Zhenla, Siam, and Suoli; Guangdong Sanfoqi and Java; Fujian Japan, Ryukyu, and Brunei; Liaodong Goryeo; Shaanxi Gansu, Do-Kham, and U-Tsang; the capital ceased sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 又從禮官言，各省山川居中南向，外國山川東西向，同壇共祀。

translations.literal: Following ritual officials' words, provincial mountains and rivers faced south at the center, foreign mountains and rivers faced east and west, and all were sacrificed to on one altar.
translations.idiomatic: Following ritual officials, provincial mountains and rivers faced south at center, foreign ones east and west, all on one altar.

sentences.zh: 其王國山川之祀，洪武十三年定制。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to princely state mountains and rivers was fixed in Hongwu 13.
translations.idiomatic: Princely sacrifice to mountains and rivers was regulated in Hongwu 13.

sentences.zh: 十八年定王國祭山川。

translations.literal: In year eighteen princely sacrifice to mountains and rivers was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year princely sacrifice to mountains and rivers was fixed.

sentences.zh: 儀同社稷，但無瘞埋之文。

translations.literal: The protocol was the same as for state and grain, but without burial text.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol matched state and grain, but without burial rites.

sentences.zh: 凡嶽鎮海瀆及他山川所在，令有司歲二祭，以清明、霜降。

translations.literal: For all peaks, garrisons, seas, rivers, and other mountains and rivers wherever located, local officials were ordered to sacrifice twice yearly at Qingming and Frost's Descent.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever peaks, garrisons, seas, rivers, and other mountains and rivers stood, local officials sacrificed twice yearly at Qingming and Frost's Descent.

sentences.zh: ○城隍

translations.literal: ● City god
translations.idiomatic: City God

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，禮官言：「城隍之祀，莫詳其始。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 2 ritual officials said: "Sacrifice to the city god—its origin is not clear in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 ritual officials reported: "Sacrifice to the city god lacks a clear origin.

sentences.zh: 先儒謂既有社，不應復有城隍。

translations.literal: Earlier scholars held that since there is already the state altar, there should not again be a city god.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier scholars held that with the state altar already established, a city god should not also exist.

sentences.zh: 故唐李陽冰《縉雲城隍記》謂『祀殿無之，惟吳越有之。

translations.literal: Thus Li Yangbing's Record of the Jinyun City God states 'there was no such temple in sacrifice halls; only Wu and Yue had it.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Li Yangbing's Record of the Jinyun City God states that 'temple sacrifice had none; only Wu and Yue had it.

sentences.zh: 』然成都城隍祠，李德裕所建，張說有祭城隍之文，杜牧有祭黃州城隍文，則不獨吳越爲然。

translations.literal: ' Yet the Chengdu city god temple was built by Li Deyu; Zhang Yue wrote a text sacrificing to the city god; Du Mu wrote a text sacrificing to the Huangzhou city god—so it was not only Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: ' Yet Chengdu's city god temple was built by Li Deyu; Zhang Yue and Du Mu both wrote city-god sacrifice texts—not only Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 又蕪湖城隍廟建於吳赤烏二年，高齊慕容儼、樑武陵王祀城隍，皆書於史，又不獨唐而已。

translations.literal: Further, the Wuhu city god temple was built in the second year of Chiwu of Wu; Murong Yan of Northern Qi and the Prince of Wuling of Liang sacrificed to the city god—all recorded in history, and not only Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuhu city god temple dates to Wu's Chiwu 2; Murong Yan of Northern Qi and the Prince of Wuling of Liang sacrificed to the city god—all in the histories, not only Tang.

sentences.zh: 宋以來其祠遍天下，或錫廟額，或頒封爵，至或遷就傅會，各指一人以爲神之姓名。

translations.literal: From Song onward its temples spread throughout the realm; some received temple plaques, some enfeoffed titles, and some even forced fit by relocation, each naming one person as the spirit's personal name.
translations.idiomatic: From Song onward temples spread empire-wide; some received plaques or enfeoffments, and some even forced identification of a single personal name for the spirit.

sentences.zh: 按張九齡《祭洪州城隍文》曰：『城隍是保，氓庶是依。

translations.literal: According to Zhang Jiuling's Sacrifice to the Hongzhou City God: 'The city god is protector; the people rely upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiuling's Sacrifice to the Hongzhou City God reads: 'The city god is protector; the people rely upon it.

sentences.zh: 』則前代崇祀之意有在也。

translations.literal: ' Thus the meaning of exalted sacrifice in former ages had its point.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thus former exalted sacrifice had its rationale.

sentences.zh: 今宜附祭於嶽瀆諸神之壇。

translations.literal: Now it is appropriate to attach sacrifice at the altar of peaks, rivers, and the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to attach sacrifice at the peaks-and-rivers altar.

sentences.zh: 」乃命加以封爵。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an order was given to add enfeoffed titles.
translations.idiomatic: An order followed to confer enfeoffed titles.

sentences.zh: 京都爲承天鑑國司民升福明靈王，開封、臨濠、太平、和州、滁州皆封爲王。

translations.literal: The capital was titled Spirit King Who Upholds Heaven, Reflects the Realm, Oversees the People, and Raises Blessings; Kaifeng, Linhuai, Taiping, Hezhou, and Chuzhou were all enfeoffed as kings.
translations.idiomatic: The capital became Spirit King Who Upholds Heaven, Reflects the Realm, Oversees the People, and Raises Blessings; Kaifeng, Linhuai, Taiping, Hezhou, and Chuzhou were enfeoffed kings.

sentences.zh: 其餘府爲鑑察司民城隍威靈公，秩正二品。

translations.literal: Other prefectures were Spirit Lord Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank正二品.
translations.idiomatic: Other prefectures were Spirit Lord Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 州爲鑑察司民城隍靈佑侯，秩三品。

translations.literal: Departments were Spirit Marquis Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank 3.
translations.idiomatic: Departments were Spirit Marquis Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank 3.

sentences.zh: 縣爲鑑察司民城隍顯佑伯，秩四品。

translations.literal: Counties were Spirit Earl Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank 4.
translations.idiomatic: Counties were Spirit Earl Who Oversees and Protects the People, rank 4.

sentences.zh: 袞章冕旒俱有差。

translations.literal: Robes, caps, and regalia all had gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Robes, caps, and regalia were graded accordingly.

sentences.zh: 命詞臣撰制文以頒之。

translations.literal: Literary officials were ordered to compose formal texts for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: Literary officials composed formal texts for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔去封號，止稱其府州縣城隍之神。

translations.literal: In year three an edict removed enfeoffed titles, styling them only Spirit of the City God of such prefecture, department, or county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year enfeoffed titles were removed; spirits were styled only City God of the prefecture, department, or county.

sentences.zh: 又令各廟屏去他神。

translations.literal: Each temple was also ordered to remove other spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Each temple was ordered to remove other spirits.

sentences.zh: 定廟制，高廣視官署廳堂。

translations.literal: Temple regulations were fixed: height and breadth like the main hall of government offices.
translations.idiomatic: Temple scale was fixed at the height and breadth of a government main hall.

sentences.zh: 造木爲主，毀塑像舁置水中，取其泥塗壁，繪以雲山。

translations.literal: Wooden spirit tablets were made; sculpted images were destroyed and cast into water; their clay was used to plaster walls and paint with cloud mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Wooden tablets replaced images; sculpted figures were cast into water; their clay plastered walls painted with clouded mountains.

sentences.zh: 六年，制中都城隍神主成，遣官齎香幣奉安。

translations.literal: In year six the Central Capital city god spirit tablet was completed; officials were dispatched bearing incense and silks for enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Central Capital city god tablet was completed; officials were sent with incense and silks for enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 京師城隍既附饗山川壇，又於二十一年改建廟。

translations.literal: The capital city god, having been attached at the mountains-and-rivers altar, had its temple rebuilt in year twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: The capital city god, attached at the mountains-and-rivers altar, had its temple rebuilt in the twenty-first year.

sentences.zh: 尋以從祀大禮殿，罷山川壇春祭。

translations.literal: Soon, because of attendant sacrifice at the Grand Rites Hall, spring sacrifice at the mountains-and-rivers altar was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, with attendant sacrifice at the Grand Rites Hall, spring sacrifice at the mountains-and-rivers altar was abolished.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，建廟都城之西，曰大威靈祠。

translations.literal: In the Yongle period a temple was built west of the capital called the Great Spirit Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongle a temple was built west of the capital called the Great Spirit Temple.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年，罷山川壇從祀，歲以仲秋祭旗纛日，並祭都城隍之神。

translations.literal: In Jiajing 9 attendant sacrifice at the mountains-and-rivers altar was abolished; each mid-autumn on the banner-and-standard day the capital city god was also sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 9 mountains-and-rivers attendant sacrifice ended; each mid-autumn on the banner-and-standard day the capital city god was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 凡聖誕節及五月十一日神誕，皆遣太常寺堂上官行禮。

translations.literal: On birthdays and on the spirit's birthday of the fifth month, eleventh day, senior Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial birthdays and the spirit's birthday on the eleventh day of the fifth month, senior Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials performed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 國有大災則告廟。

translations.literal: When the state suffered great disaster, the temple was notified.
translations.idiomatic: When the state suffered great disaster, the temple was notified.

sentences.zh: 在王國者王親祭之，在各府州縣者守令主之。

translations.literal: In princely states the prince sacrificed in person; in prefectures, departments, and counties the defending official presided.
translations.idiomatic: In princely states the prince sacrificed in person; in prefectures, departments, and counties the local official presided.
